title.rendered: Arqaam Capital selects Nasdaq eVestment Omni to optimize its market presence

content.rendered:
With 40 direct investors representing $5T in AUM across the Middle East and Africa, Arqaam is proud to announce our partnership with eVestment, A Part of Nasdaq the leading database for institutional managers.

View More
